full_judgment: 37. Now comes the matter of absence of independent and disinterested witnesses in this case. In the instant case all the prosecution witnesses appeared to be related to each other. Witnesses from amongst the neighbours were not examined by the prosecution. Non examination of independent and relevant witnesses goes against the prosecution and creates presumption under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act and creates a doubt upon the prosecution case and it is to be presumed that had they been examined by the prosecution they would not have supported the prosecution case. Thus the benefit of this defect will go in favour of the defence.
